title: Spinlock Guard
goal: Build a lock acquisition loop using atomic compare_exchange_weak.
hints: `compare_exchange_weak` is idiomatic inside spin loops because it can fail spuriously yielding better performance on ARM.
The while loop should continue spinning as long as the atomic exchange fails (returns `Err`).
explanation: `compare_exchange_weak(false, true, ...)` tries to flip the flag from free to held and returns `Err` while someone else holds it, so `while ... .is_err()` is the loop that waits. `.err()` gives an `Option<bool>`, which is not a condition, so the `while` does not compile. `.unwrap_err()` panics the moment the swap succeeds. `swap` and `store` return a plain `bool` and `()`, neither of which has these methods.
